#Region "Main"
    COMMENT  Dotted action format sample (newer PAD exports)
    DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime TimeZone: TimeZoneInfo.Local => CurrentDateTime
    Text.ToText TextToConvert: %CurrentDateTime% => CurrentDateText
    Variables.SetVariable NewValue: $'''%CurrentDateText%''' Name: DisplayDate
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Current date: %DisplayDate%''' Icon: Display.Icon.Information Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 => ButtonPressed
    LOOP FOREACH Item IN %ItemList%
        IF %Item% = Special
            Text.ToUpper Text: %Item% => UpperItem
            Variables.SetVariable NewValue: %UpperItem% Name: ProcessedItem
        ELSE
            Variables.SetVariable NewValue: %Item% Name: ProcessedItem
        END
    END
    ON BLOCK ERROR
        Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Error occurred''' Icon: Display.Icon.Error
    END
    WebAutomation.LaunchBrowser BrowserType: WebAutomation.BrowserType.Chrome Timeout: 30 => Browser
    WebAutomation.NavigateTo Url: $'''https://example.com''' BrowserInstance: %Browser%
    WebAutomation.CloseBrowser BrowserInstance: %Browser%
#EndRegion
#Region "DataProcessing"
    Excel.LaunchExcel Visible: True => ExcelInstance
    Excel.ReadFromExcelExcelFileToRead: CurrentExcelFile Instance: %ExcelInstance% ReadOption: Excel.ReadOption.CellRange Range: $'''A1:D100''' => ExcelData
    LOOP FOREACH CurrentRow IN %ExcelData%
        SET RowData TO %CurrentRow%
        IF %RowData['Active']% = True
            COMMENT  Process active row
            Text.Concatenate Text1: %RowData['FirstName']% Text2: $''' ''' Text3: %RowData['LastName']% => FullName
            Variables.SetVariable NewValue: %FullName% Name: CurrentUserName
        END
    END
    Excel.CloseExcel Instance: %ExcelInstance% SaveBeforeClosing: True
    File.WriteText File: $'''C:\output\results.txt''' TextToWrite: $'''Processed user: %CurrentUserName%''' Encoding: File.TextEncoding.UTF8
#EndRegion
